newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates up despite liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates up despite liquidity.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates for the Egyptian pound rose on Sunday to between 7-1/4 and 8-1/4 percent from Wednesday's range of 4-1/2 to 6 percent in a liquid private sector market, bankers said.
One-week rates also increased to 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent from between 6 to 6-1/8 percent, they added.

Bankers are still attributing the liquidity to the rejection of many bids because of lower rates in last week's treasury bill auction. Some also said fewer than usual auctions due to holidays had caused the liquidity.
Banks closed on Thursday for the first day of the Islamic calendar and Friday and Saturday are weekend.
Bankers said that public sector banks had kept their minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
